name: replace_white_with_pink_noise
mechanism: Replaces white noise with pink noise for murmur and background noise generation to better model the energy roll-off of fluid turbulence and prevent unrealistic zero-crossing rates.

name: severity_dependent_frequency_mapping
mechanism: Derives the lower and upper cutoff frequencies of the murmur bandpass filter as a linear function of defect severity to model the physiological relationship between defect size and pitch.

name: decrease_high_pass_filter_order
mechanism: Decreasing the high-pass filter order provides a gentler roll-off that allows more natural low-frequency energy to pass, improving the spectral balance of the synthesized signal.
code_snippet: b_hp, a_hp = signal.butter(2, murmur_low / nyq, btype='high')
